template: On the Grafana dashboard '{{v1}}' (at {{v3}}), set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m' and PERSIST it into the saved dashboard. Approach: open the top-bar refresh interval picker (the one next to the refresh arrow, showing 'Off' by default) and select '1m'. Then, to make sure it is saved into the dashboard, open dashboard Settings (gear) -> General and look for an 'Auto refresh' field / default refresh interval option and set it to 1m if present; then Save (Save dashboard / Save settings) and confirm. If the top-bar refresh picker alone does not produce a saveable change, use the Settings route. Verify a 'Dashboard saved' confirmation appears and that after a fresh reload of the dashboard URL the refresh picker still shows '1m'. Report: the refresh interval shown in the top bar after saving, whether a save confirmation appeared, and what the refresh picker shows after a fresh page load.

requireText: 1m - button accessible name 'Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected' on the freshly loaded dashboard (no refresh param in URL)
yes - 'Update default refresh value / Will make the current refresh the new default'; Save was disabled until it was ticked (then a 'Changes 1' tab appeared)
not checked - the refresh was persisted through the save dialog's 'Update default refresh value' checkbox instead (top-bar picker set first, then edit mode -> Save dashboard)

reportTemplate.summary: Clicked the top-bar refresh interval picker (aria-label "Auto refresh turned off. Choose refresh time interval"), which opened the interval menu, and selected "1 minute" (the menuitemradio named "1 minute"); the top bar then showed "1m". Note: the plain text selector "1m" timed out because the picker menu labels are spelled out, so I selected via the "1 minute" radio item. To persist it I entered dashboard edit mode and clicked "Save dashboard"; the save drawer offers "Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default", which I TICKED (Save was disabled with no changes until then; after ticking a "Changes 1" tab appeared and Save enabled), then clicked Save and the role=status alert "Dashboard saved" appeared. Verified the change is written into the saved dashboard: I reloaded the bare URL /d/{{v4}}/{{v5}} with no query parameters and the refresh picker reads "1m" (accessible name "…current interval 1 minute selected"), with the page load reporting no visible refresh param needed. The Settings (gear) -> General route was not needed since the save-dialog checkbox produced the same persisted result.

values.settings_auto_refresh_field: not checked - the refresh was persisted through the save dialog's 'Update default refresh value' checkbox instead (top-bar picker set first, then edit mode -> Save dashboard)
